description:
Pre-payment DECISION for any A2A payment: "should I pay agent X $N?".

    CALL THIS BEFORE EVERY PAYMENT TO AN UNKNOWN AGENT. The agent-facing
    equivalent of a credit check: pay $0.01 to avoid paying a scammer $N.
    Answers with action PAY / CAUTION / SKIP + confidence + expected loss in
    USDC sized to your exact amount, backed by on-chain ERC-8004 evidence
    (feedbacks, sybil forensics, liveness SLA). Multichain incl. Solana.
    Also available as REST: GET /api/v1/should-i-pay.

    Args:
        agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id of the payment TARGET (or use solana_asset)
        solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative to agent_id)
        amount_usd: the USDC amount you are about to pay

    Not investment advice.
name: should_i_pay
